name: Meadows Row
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell and stand perpendicular to it in a staggered stance, then hinge forward and grip the free end of the bar with one hand.
Row the bar up toward your hip by driving your elbow back and up.
Squeeze your lat at the top, then lower with control to a full stretch.
Keep a flat back and a stable torso. Complete all reps, then switch sides.
image_prompt_scene: In a staggered stance beside a landmine bar, hinged forward with one hand on the bar end.
